title: Spontaneous passivation of selective Zn(101) plating via dangling bond saturation and electrostatic interaction regulation for high-utilization, fast-kinetics zinc anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3852-3868
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05498A, Paper

Yuxuan Zhang, Minyoung Kim, Dong Hun Lee, Fei Qin, Han-Wook Song, Chung Soo Kim, Jeongmin Park, Chohee Kim, Fang Lian, Sunghwan Lee
Enhanced Zn anode kinetics and reversibility are achieved at a high ZUR by guiding Zn2+ plating underlying the SnO1.17 interphase with a regulated (101) orientation, surpassing those achieved by inducing Zn(002) plating overlying the interphase.
